source_facts: ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT_2 (1177) can leave the original only at the supplied backup path
Replacement, replaced file and backup must reside on the same volume
local_source_at_review: product/packaging/install.ps1: File.Replace backup under temporary work, unconditional work-directory removal in finally
finding: A documented partial replacement failure can leave recovery bytes in the work directory which unconditional cleanup removes. Put recovery on destination volume and retain it on unconfirmed failure.
